description: This file defines the CodePage class for handling character encoding conversions and mappings in the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes constants for common code pages, a map of code page identifiers to encoding names, and methods for validation, conversion, and retrieval of encodings.

classes.name: CodePage
classes.description: A utility class for mapping code page identifiers to encoding names and validating code pages.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks if the provided code page string or number exists in the known list.

methods.name: numberToName
methods.description: Converts a Microsoft code page number to its corresponding encoding name recognized by iconv and mbstring.

methods.name: getEncodings
methods.description: Returns the array of known code page mappings.
